service.description: A location from the current user in a plain room (a member, not archived): location {latitude, longitude (both, in range; rounded to 6 places), label (up to 100), address (up to 300), accuracy (metres), source (here or typed)}, the coordinates or an address or both. send#Message with its words ("Location: label, address" and the map link) as the body, then content.location and the update pushed. replyToEventSeq, threadRootEventSeq, clientRef and roomUrl as send#Message. Refused: an encrypted room (encryptedRoom: the browser sends the place in the ciphertext there), a place that is not one (badLocation). Out: eventSeq, event (with location), duplicate, reasonCode.

Share the current user's live location with a plain room's members (plans/Location-Sharing.md §3.5, LL4): a share (LocationServices.create#Share) whose audience is the room's local users in it now, as users, but the caller, its agents, those who put the room out of sight, accounts that cannot sign in, those the caller blocked, and those the chat directory keeps from the caller or who blocked them; until thruDate (within location@max-share-hours), exact or approximate (precisionEnumId), no trail; then a message whose words say whose live location it is (the full name, never the username), for how long from now, and that live updates are in the app (with the room's link when the server's address is known), and whose content.location is {liveShareId, label, thruDate, approximate, source live}: the share's id, never a position, so a bridge or a text gets those words only; the room and message kept with the share's id (ChatLiveShare). A person who joins the room later is not added, one who leaves by themselves stays in the share until its owner takes them out (Who sees my location), and one taken out of the room by another or blocked by the owner loses it (revokeLive). replyToEventSeq, threadRootEventSeq, clientRef (a send again by it answers the first message with its share's shareId, thruDate and intervalSeconds, duplicate true, and starts no second share) and roomUrl as send#Message. Refused: not a member (notMember, checked first, so a non-member learns nothing of the room), an encrypted room (encryptedRoom: the server would see each position), nobody else to see it (noAudience), and create#Share's refusals (its reasonCode, and nothing kept). Out: eventSeq, event (with location), shareId, thruDate (epoch millis), intervalSeconds (the share's report interval), duplicate, reasonCode.

A live location message's share as the current user may see it (plans/Location-Sharing.md §3.5): the message read by get#Timeline (only one who reads the room gets anything), the share through LocationServices.get#Share (which checks its current audience and is the only read of a position). state live (latest: the position received since the caller was reached, or none yet), ended, or notShared (on, and the caller is not in its audience: one who joined the room after it started, or whom its owner took out); owner; share {shareId, label, ownerName, thruDate, approximate, and for the owner audienceVersion, sentFromDevice, deviceName, fromThisDevice, audienceCount, intervalSeconds, leftRoomNames: the people it still reaches who left the room by themselves}. A share id in a message not by the share's owner reads as no share. Refused: notFound.

Internal (plans/Location-Sharing.md §3.5, the LL4 decisions): userId taken out of the live locations of chatRoomId (a member taken out of the room by another: remove#Member) or of ownerUserId's live locations in every room (the owner blocked them: ChatBlocks.js blockUser), those still on only. Registered to run once the removal or the block has committed, so one rolled back takes nobody out; LocationServices.revoke#ChatAudience takes each share in a transaction of its own. Never fails: a failure is logged. Out: revokedCount.

Internal: the words of a place as a location message has them (for an inbound RCS location, Sms.js), and the place checked. A place that is not one (coordinates out of range, a label alone) keeps its words with no link ("Location: label") and location null, with no error. Out: text, location.

Internal: a received message (an inbound RCS location, Sms.js) is a location: content.location (source network) set and pushed as an update. A place that is not one is logged and left out; the text stays. Out: marked.
